notes: The single the of the cities of refuge is the rectum's article fronted (rule 29), the rectum being rendered anarthrously; the construct עָרֵי keeps only its own word.
בְּיַד → by is fused under rule 30, headed on the construct noun; contrast JOS.20.9, where the ASV writes a word for each morpheme and rule 2 splits the pair.
The dative lamed of לָכֶם is unrepresented and its suffix takes you, exactly as rule 40's תְּנָה לִּי → give me.
